23157-other-people-s-business-the-romant.creator: Harriet Lummis Smith
23157-other-people-s-business-the-romant.description: A book by Harriet Lummis Smith. Having thus tactfully interfered for the preservation of her property, Persis cast a swiftly appraising glance at the chair her caller had vacated. "Front rung sprung just as I expected," was her unspoken comment. "It's a wonder that Etta West don't use more discretion about furniture."

arxiv-1811-11770.title: Operads with compatible CL-shellable partition posets admit a Poincaré–Birkhoff–Witt basis Thanks: This work was partially supported by the LabEx CIMI, the grants ANR-13-BS02-0005-02 project CATHRE, ANR-14-CE25-0008-01 project SAT, ANR-16-CE40-0003 project ChroK
arxiv-1811-11770.creator: Joan Bellier-Millès, Bérénice Delcroix-Oger, Eric Hoffbeck
arxiv-1811-11770.description: Abstract . In 2007, Vallette built a bridge across posets and operads by proving that an operad is Koszul if and only if the associated partition posets are Cohen-Macaulay. Both notions of being Koszul and being Cohen–Macaulay admit different refinements: our goal here is to link two of these refinements.

arxiv-1911-06784.title: Learning an Optimally Reduced Formulation of OPF through Meta-optimization
arxiv-1911-06784.creator: Alex Robson, Mahdi Jamei, Cozmin Ududec, Letif Mones
arxiv-1911-06784.description: Abstract With increasing share of renewables in power generation mix, system operators would need to run Optimal Power Flow (OPF) problems closer to real-time to better manage uncertainty. Given that OPF is an expensive optimization problem to solve, shifting computational effort away from real-time to offline training by machine learning techniques has become an intense research area.

arxiv-2007-01388.title: Learn Faster and Forget Slower via Fast and Stable Task Adaptation
arxiv-2007-01388.creator: Farshid Varno f.varno@dal.ca, Lucas May Petry lucas.petry@posgrad.ufsc.br, Lisa Di Jorio lisa@imagia.com, Stan Matwin stan@cs.dal.ca
arxiv-2007-01388.description: Abstract Training Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) is still highly time-consuming and compute-intensive. It has been shown that adapting a pretrained model may significantly accelerate this process. With a focus on classification, we show that current fine-tuning techniques make the pretrained models catastrophically forget the transferred knowledge even before anything about the new task is learned.

arxiv-2102-02143.title: Estimating the radii of air bubbles in water using passive acoustic monitoring
arxiv-2102-02143.creator: P. Hubert, L. Padovese
arxiv-2102-02143.description: Abstract The study of the acoustic emission of underwater gas bubbles is a subject of both theoretical and applied interest, since it finds an important application in the development of acoustic monitoring tools for detection and quantification of underwater gas leakages.

arxiv-2109-13047.title: A NOTE ON TWO CLASSES OF HYPERIDEALS
arxiv-2109-13047.creator: M. Anbarloei
arxiv-2109-13047.description: Abstract . Let R R be a commutative multiplicative hyperring with 1. In this paper, we define the concepts of r-hyperideal and n-hyperideal of the hyperring R R which are two new classes of hyperideals. Several properties of them are provided.

arxiv-2112-00605.title: On matter and pressure distribution in nucleons Journal: PEPAN Letters
arxiv-2112-00605.creator: Roberto Fiore a, , László Jenkovszky b, , Maryna Oleksiienko c,
arxiv-2112-00605.description: Abstract Matter and pressure distribution in hadrons are studied in a dual analytic model of generalized parton distributions with complex Regge trajectories. An original parametrization of the pressure distribution in the nucleon is proposed, ensuring its stability and compatible with the experimental data from the JLab accelerator. PACS: 13.75, 12.38.-t, 12.40.

arxiv-2303-08559.title: Large Language Model Is Not a Good Few-shot Information Extractor , but a Good Reranker for Hard Samples!
arxiv-2303-08559.creator: Yubo Ma, Yixin Cao, YongChing Hong, Aixin Sun
arxiv-2303-08559.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable strides in various tasks. Whether LLMs are competitive few-shot solvers for information extraction (IE) tasks, however, remains an open problem. In this work, we aim to provide a thorough answer to this question.

arxiv-2403-12403.title: Towards Interpretable Hate Speech Detection using Large Language Model-extracted Rationales
arxiv-2403-12403.creator: Ayushi Nirmal Amrita Bhattacharjee Paras Sheth Huan LiuSchool of Computing and Augmented IntelligenceArizona State University {anirmal1, abhatt43, psheth5, huanliu}@asu.edu
arxiv-2403-12403.description: Abstract Although social media platforms are a prominent arena for users to engage in interpersonal discussions and express opinions, the facade and anonymity offered by social media may allow users to spew hate speech and offensive content. Given the massive scale of such platforms, there arises a need to automatically identify and flag instances of hate speech.

arxiv-2407-14517.title: A group theoretic condition equivalent to a condition on principal blocks
arxiv-2407-14517.creator: Geoffrey R. Robinson
arxiv-2407-14517.description: Abstract In this note, we consider the question: if G G is a finite group, which complex irreducible characters χ \chi of G G belong to the principal p p -block of G G for every prime divisor p p of G G ?

arxiv-2508-09944.title: Poset-enriched pretoposes and compact ordered spaces
arxiv-2508-09944.creator: Jérémie Marquès, Luca Reggio
arxiv-2508-09944.description: Abstract . We provide a characterisation of the category 𝖪𝖮𝗋𝖽 \KOrd of Nachbin’s compact ordered spaces as a poset-enriched category. Up to equivalence, 𝖪𝖮𝗋𝖽 \KOrd is the only non-degenerate poset-enriched pretopos whose terminal object is a (discrete) generator and in which every object is covered by an order-filtral object. Order-filtral objects satisfy an appropriate form of compactness and separation.

pmc-10542697.title: Online decision tools for personalized survival prediction and treatment optimization in elderly patients with lung squamous cell carcinoma: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-10542697.creator: Chen-ye Shao, Jing Luo, Sheng Ju, Chu-ling Li, Cheng Ding, Jun Chen, Xiao-long Liu, Jun Zhao, Li-qin Yang
pmc-10542697.description: BackgroundDespite major advances in cancer therapeutics, the therapeutic options of Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma (LSCC)-specific remain limited. Furthermore, the current staging system is imperfect for defining a prognosis and guiding treatment due to its simplicity and heterogeneity. We sought to develop prognostic decision tools for individualized survival prediction and treatment optimization in elderly patients with LSCC.

pmc-10605820.title: Enhanced Recovery after Surgery (ERAS) for Minimally Invasive Gynecologic Oncology Surgery: A Review
pmc-10605820.creator: Christa Aubrey, Gregg Nelson
pmc-10605820.description: Enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) has established benefits in open gynecologic oncology surgery. However, the benefits for gynecologic oncology patients undergoing minimally invasive surgery (MIS) are less well defined. We conducted a review of this topic after a comprehensive search of the peer-reviewed literature using MEDLINE and PubMed databases.

pmc-10649187.title: Living Donors’ Age Modifies the Impact of Pre-Donation Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate on Graft Survival
pmc-10649187.creator: Manuela Almeida, Catarina Ribeiro, José Silvano, Sofia Pedroso, Sandra Tafulo, La Salete Martins, Miguel Ramos, Jorge Malheiro
pmc-10649187.description: Background: The global scarcity of organs for kidney transplants (KTs) has led to the increased acceptance of living donors (LDs) with minor abnormalities to increase the donor pool.. We sought to evaluate the effects of some of these LDs’ clinical characteristics (older age, borderline renal function, hypertension, dyslipidemia, smoking, and obesity) on graft outcomes.

pmc-11382063.title: Decreased Serum CTRP3 level was associated with connective tissue diseases
pmc-11382063.creator: Lisha Ma, Jiangbo Lin, Miaoli Shao, Binxuan Chen, Renfang Zhou, Jianfeng Shi
pmc-11382063.description: ObjectiveComplement C1q tumor necrosis factor-related protein 3 (CTRP3) and 9 (CTRP9) are two of the most extensively studied adipokines, known for their diverse biological functions. However, it remains unclear whether serum levels of CTRP3 or CTRP9 are associated with connective tissue diseases (CTD).

pmc-12597198.title: Advancing the treatment of NTRK-fused pediatric solid tumors: lessons from the ADVL1823 study
pmc-12597198.creator: Carolina Sgarioni Camargo Vince, Elvis Terci Valera
pmc-12597198.description: gnostic targeted therapy in pediatric oncology (1). Fusions of NTRK1, NTRK2, or NTRK3 most commonly arise from rearrangements with unrelated partner genes, constituting the principal oncogenic alteration within this family. The resulting chimeric protein retains constitutive activation or is aberrantly overexpressed, acting as a critical driver of tumor initiation and progression.

pmc-12643550.title: Battle beyond membrane: flagella as a conduit for phage DNA entry and a trigger for bacterial defense in Yersinia enterocolitica
pmc-12643550.creator: Zijing Wang, Wei Chen, Enming Wang, Shuai Le, Wenyu Han, Shuai Yuan, Jingmin Gu, Bing Liu
pmc-12643550.description: Bacterial flagella are known for facilitating motility to support nutrient acquisition and predator evasion, but can also serve as receptors for phages. Here, we characterize a dual role of flagella during infection of Yersinia enterocolitica by phage X1: functioning as a conduit for phage DNA entry and as a trigger for bacterial defense.

pmc-12939789.title: Proteomic landscape of colorectal cancer liver metastasis: molecular signatures and novel therapeutic targets
pmc-12939789.creator: Hongyuan Shen, Jia Li, Guoqing Wang, Xiangyu Su, Zhigang Zhang, Jinjun Shi
pmc-12939789.description: BackgroundLiver metastasis accounts for most deaths in colorectal cancer patients, but we still lack a clear understanding of how this devastating process unfolds at the molecular level. Identifying these mechanisms could lead to better ways to predict and treat metastatic disease.

pmc-13063894.title: Risk factors for maladaptive grief and posttraumatic stress in children and adolescents following loss: a systematic review
pmc-13063894.creator: Philipp Jann, Neele Winkler, Harald Karutz, Veronika Hulde, Tobias Hecker
pmc-13063894.description: BackgroundTraumatic losses in childhood and adolescence can evoke both maladaptive grief symptoms (MGS) and posttraumatic stress symptoms (PTSS). The aim of this study was to systematically review the existing literature to identify which risk factors are shared by both phenomenologies or differentiate between them.MethodsThe systematic review was pre-registered in PROSPERO and conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines.

pmc-13098157.title: Diagnostic Value of Neutrophil CD64 in Differentiating Scrub Typhus From Febrile Diseases
pmc-13098157.creator: Jing Su, Junyi Chen, Xuan Shen, Yaoyun Zhang, Wenya Li, Jijin Qi, Qing Zhong, Tianyu Sun, Siqi Shi, Fang Zhu, Youde Yan
pmc-13098157.description: BackgroundScrub typhus, lacks specific early symptoms, and traditional serological tests have low sensitivity. This study shows that CD64 has superior diagnostic performance compared to CRP and PCT in bacterial infections.MethodsThis retrospective study analyzed 242 febrile patients admitted to the Jiangsu Province (Suqian) Hospital (January 2023–December 2024), categorized into non‐specific fever (n = 186) and scrub typhus (n = 56).

pmc-13397593.title: Efficacy and safety of RTS, S and R21 malaria vaccines in children under five in Africa: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-13397593.creator: Khulud Mahmood Nurani, Najib Kadernani, Emmanuel Korir, Merna Akram Estreed, Arkadeep Dhali, Rugut Clinton, Khalid Kadernani, Vincent Kipkorir, Pius Omullo, Moses Masika
pmc-13397593.description: BackgroundMalaria remains a major public health burden in Africa, particularly among children under five years of age. By consolidating findings across randomized controlled trials on the RTS,S and R21 malaria vaccines, this study seeks to provide an evidence based guide.

pmc-13588937.title: Decoding Medial Entorhinal Cortical Dynamics Produces Planning‐Like Alternations in Hippocampal theta Sequences
pmc-13588937.creator: Masahiro Nakano, Caswell Barry, Claudia Clopath
pmc-13588937.description: The hippocampus is central to memory and spatial planning. A prominent candidate mechanism supporting navigational decision making is hippocampal theta sequences—brief (~120 ms) place‐cell sequences representing future trajectories—which have been interpreted as planning signals based on their alternation between maze arms in T‐maze tasks.

uslaw-usc-t42-s3199.title: 42 U.S.C. § 3199 — Office of Disaster Recovery and Resilience
uslaw-usc-t42-s3199.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s3199.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 38 (Public Works And Economic Development); Subchapter V (Administration). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Establishment The Secretary shall establish an Office of Disaster Recovery and Resilience— (1) to direct and implement the post-disaster economic recovery responsibilities of the Economic Development Administration pursuant to subsections (c)(2) and (e) of section 3149.
